result_summary: The fixed STRUCTURE_THRESHOLD 0.90 does not transfer across articles. Converted to closeness, the E11 H55 ladders put ibm rung-2 at 0.892817 and wergeland rung-2 at 0.908048, so 0.90 mis-sides exactly 1 of 12 rungs, reading wergeland's genuine rearrangement as 'similar order', while falsely flagging 0 of 72 un-reordered pairs. A sweep of 0.85 to 0.99 at 0.005 steps finds 0 of 29 thresholds safe on both articles: wergeland needs a threshold above 0.908048 while ibm cannot exceed 0.906144 without flagging its gold-2 ~ haiku diffuse pair, an overshoot of 0.001904 closeness, so ibm's band (0.892817, 0.906144] and wergeland's (0.908048, 0.973676] are disjoint. Acceptance passes on branch (b), the demonstrated empty band, and per-corpus structural calibration is the guidance; the shipped 0.90 stays correct for ibm with 0.006144 of headroom and is an ibm constant, not a transferable one.
caveats: The 12 ladder rungs are displacement-bin means read from the E11 report, not per-permutation readings, so each rung averages its bin's sampled permutations and carries a spread this probe does not resolve; wergeland's un-reordered population is only 3 diffuse plus 3 paraphrase pairs, so its band's upper edge rests on few observations. Per-pair diffuse values are not in the E11 report (medians only), so all 72 un-reordered pairs were rebuilt through the E11 notebook path: the 55 ibm and 3 wergeland cross_summary pairs and the 14 paraphrase pairs from data/processed/structure-fixture/pairs.json, re-encoded with the torch mmBERT encoder on CPU where E11 used an RTX 5000 Ada; the medians agree to 0.000141 order-gap units, well inside the 0.001904 band overshoot, so the empty-band conclusion does not depend on that difference. Two articles are the whole evidence base for the transfer claim, so the direction is established but the size of the disagreement on a third corpus is not. Process note for the orchestrator: the campaign scratchpad is shared by all executors and a filename collision on build_nb.py made one command of mine rebuild E12-H61's notebook from its own builder; it held no outputs at the time and H61's executor has since rebuilt and executed it, so no H61 artefact carries anything of mine.
